findings.issue: The task asserts in three places that the user-spec says 'три оговорки' and must be synced to four. That is false: the user-spec already says «четыре оговорки» in its acceptance criteria (013-feat-activity-xmin-horizon.md:213-214, all four enumerated including the privileges one) and «все четыре оговорки» in the «Как проверить» table, row 9 (:375). Both cited line numbers are also off by one (:213 -> :214, :374 -> :375; :374 is in fact the sorting row). The Post-completion item therefore sends the executor to 'fix' an approved document that is already correct, and the Description's «Почему четыре, а не три» rationale rests on a premise that no longer holds. This is the same class of defect as the round-1 finding about `pgcenter top` reading descriptions -- a confident claim about a source of truth that does not survive checking.
findings.fix: Drop the Post-completion user-spec sync item entirely. In Description, replace the «Почему четыре, а не три» paragraph with a plain statement that the user-spec (:213-217), the tech-spec Acceptance Criteria and the Risks table all require four caveats and agree with each other. In Context Files, remove the note «его список критериев приёмки говорит про *три* оговорки — это устаревший счёт»; the user-spec is a valid source for the caveat count.
